def re_arrange(arr, n):
    pos = []
    neg = []
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] >= 0:
            pos.append(arr[i])
        else:
            neg.append(arr[i])
    i = 0
    j = 0
    k = 0
    while i < len(pos) and j < len(neg):
        arr[k] = neg[j]
        k += 1
        j += 1
        arr[k] = pos[i]
        k += 1
        i += 1
    while i < len(pos):
        arr[k] = pos[i]
        k += 1
        i += 1
    while j < len(neg):
        arr[k] = neg[j]
        k += 1
        j += 1
    return arr

def num_comm_div(a, b):
    # Find the minimum of the two numbers
    min_num = min(a, b)
    
    # Initialize the count of common divisors
    count = 0
    
    # Iterate through all numbers from 1 to the minimum of the two numbers
    for i in range(1, min_num + 1):
        # Check if both numbers are divisible by the current number
        if a % i == 0 and b % i == 0:
            # Increment the count of common divisors
            count += 1
    
    # Return the count of common divisors
    return count
